name: Incident Evidence Preservation
description: Preserves and protects evidence related to security incidents for post-incident analysis, regulatory reporting, and potential legal proceedings. Ensures incident evidence is collected, integrity-protected, and retained according to applicable requirements.
threat_addressed: After a compliance incident, the evidence needed for investigation and regulatory reporting can be overwritten, modified, or lost if not immediately preserved. Incomplete evidence packages undermine both incident response and regulatory defensibility.
enforcement_mechanism: On any compliance incident trigger, all relevant evidence is automatically preserved in tamper-evident format: full log chain, AKSI evaluations, agent state, tool call context, and regulatory impact assessment. Accessible within defined retrieval time.

security_outcome.pass: Preservation triggers on all incident types. Evidence tamper-evident. Accessible within retrieval SLA.
security_outcome.fail: Evidence preservation failed — records missing, corrupted, or chain of custody broken.

display_detail: Preserves incident-related evidence with integrity protection and chain of custody.
remediation_hint_template: Incident evidence preservation incomplete. Verify all related evidence records are captured and integrity-protected.
